title: Judgment standard
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0007 no longer matches the current design.
decision: A check is adequate when it rejects the plausible failure modes its example names. A contrived way around it is recorded as future work on the check, never as a finding against the work.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
